name: iris-verify-ui
title_zh: 截图比对不靠肉眼，像素级差异自动圈出
tagline_zh: 改完前端拿不准有没有走样？不用再开两窗口来回扫。它替你逐像素比对参考图，偏差位置直接标出来。
tagline_en: Stop eyeballing two screenshots. It pixel-diffs UI against a reference, pinpoints regressions, and rechecks until.
desc_en: Verify web UIs, HTML, and interface screenshots with dsh-iris through repeatable capture, semantic inspection, element location, cropping, pixel-diff analysis, and bounded rechecks. Use when comparing a UI with a reference image, locating visual regressions, validating frontend changes, or matching an implementation to a design. 用于对照参考图检查界面、定位视觉偏差、验证前端修改或比较两张 UI 截图。
why_zh: 不是简单叠图看透明度——它先语义定位元素再裁切比对，排除字体渲染和滚动条这类无关噪声。
why_en: It locates elements semantically before cropping and diffing, filtering out font-rendering and scrollbar noise so only real.
limit_zh: 只认浏览器渲染出的界面截图或 HTML，不认设计稿 PDF 或 Figma 导出图；比对需有明确参考图。
limit_en: Only for browser-rendered UIs or HTML against a reference screenshot; not for PDFs or Figma exports. Large resolution mismatches need manual.
title_en: Pixel-diff UI checker that flags visual regressions
